title: Mind Sundering Dagger
summary: Unobtainable +1 dagger with an extra 1d4 Psychic on hits.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d4 + 1 Piercing plus applicable ability modifier, and 1d4 Psychic on a hit. Simple one-handed melee, 5 ft, Finesse, Light, Thrown, Dippable.
fields.Piercing Strike: With proficiency, Action once per Short Rest. Deal weapon damage on a melee hit. A Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2 prevents Gaping Wounds for 2 turns. Undead and Constructs are immune. Healing clears it.
fields.Gaping Wounds: In standard modes, hits on the creature deal 2 extra Piercing. In Honour Mode any damage source adds 2 of its original damage type.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources.
